data.desc: Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) is a global apparel company with deep authority in the denim, outdoor and workwear categories. Wrangler and Helly Hansen are iconic brands that empower consumers to pursue their passions with confidence and authenticity through innovative design, exceptional products and compelling performance. Kontoor's global platform, scale and operational expertise drive sustainable brand growth and deliver long-term value for its stakeholders.
